purpose: Teach: 親御/チェス/ブラームス/目覚める/下山/泥沼/すっと/彷彿

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、家庭訪問で、本気で、絶対、先生、絶対、親御、絶対、さんに、絶対、お話、絶対、するんだよね
lines.en: Riku — your homeroom teacher's definitely going to bring up chess with your parents, right?
lines.style: Quick, teasing lilt. Leans forward slightly. A little conspiratorial — she's testing him, seeing if he'll get embarrassed. Warm underneath the needling.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。お父さんと、本気で、絶対、休日に、絶対、チェス、絶対、よくやるんだぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. Dad and I play it all the time on weekends, actually. Seriously.
lines.style: Casual, almost defensive but in a good-natured way. Small laugh underneath — aware of how it sounds. Meets her energy without backing down.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 音楽の授業で、本気で、絶対、ブラームス、絶対、聴いたよね、リク
lines.en: We listened to Brahms in music class the other day. Remember?
lines.style: Softer now. A small pause before 'Brahms,' like she's noticing something she didn't say before. Reflective, a little wondering. Not accusatory — observant.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 試験前、本気で、絶対、朝、絶対、ちゃんと、絶対、目覚める、絶対、よう、絶対、頑張るぜ、桜
lines.en: I'm trying to wake up properly before tests, actually. Really putting in the effort.
lines.style: Earnest shift. Sits up slightly straighter. There's effort in this sentence — he means it. Not boasting, just stating what he's doing. A little vulnerable in that honesty.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 登山部、本気で、絶対、下山、絶対、する時の、絶対、注意、絶対、お前、絶対、徹底してるよね、リク
lines.en: When we do mountain club descents, you're always so careful about safety. Thorough.
lines.style: Clear admiration in the tone. She's noticing something real about him and saying it plainly. No false cheerfulness — genuine respect. Holds the words lightly, lets them land.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 前期、本気で、絶対、勉強が、絶対、泥沼、絶対、状態だったぜ、桜
lines.en: Last term though — studying was a complete mess. I was drowning in it.
lines.style: Self-deprecating, wry. A small exhale like he's laughing at himself. Not dwelling in it, just naming it. Quick, honest, moving past it without shame.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、最近、絶対、すっと、絶対、背筋、絶対、伸びてるよね、リク
lines.en: You've been standing straighter lately. Shoulders back. I've noticed.
lines.style: Quiet observation. She's speaking carefully — this is tender, not teasing. Meets his eyes slightly longer than usual. The compliment lands because she means it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、お母さんを、絶対、彷彿、絶対、と、絶対、させるぜ、桜
lines.en: You really remind me of your mom sometimes. The way you are.
lines.style: Soft, close. A little vulnerable — this is affection, not irony. He's lowering his guard. The compliment reaches toward something he cares about deeply. Almost tender.
